remarks: Welcome to Vantage Point, one of East Norwalk's premier Waterfront communities. This immaculate and stunning 2-bedroom, 2-full-bath condo offers effortless, single-level living located directly on Norwalk Harbor, with unobstructed panoramic views of Long Island Sound.  Perfectly situated on the third floor, Unit #3I combines modern comfort with a coastal lifestyle that feels like waking up to a vacation every day. Step into bright, open-concept living, with a dining area leading to the floor-to-ceiling sliders that open to the expansive balcony overlooking the Harbor and the Sound. It is the ideal spot to sip your morning coffee, al fresco dining, or unwinding to spectacular sunsets. The welcoming and bright kitchen features ample storage, a breakfast nook, and large work island. The spacious primary bedroom suite opens onto the balcony with abundant closet space, and a full ensuite bath with tasteful updates. The second bedroom is perfect for guests or a home office, and has its own full bath with tub just across the hall. Additional highlights include three additional closets, secure fob entry system, carpeted floors, and in-unit laundry combo. Residents of Vantage Point enjoy premium amenities including direct waterfront access for your boat or kayak, a heated in-ground pool with private boardwalk, elevators, a covered parking space, and secure storage unit.
